description.narrative: Maris has a commitment with its DFI investor(s) to further improve social and HuR risk management within the company’s portfolio. FMO aims to support this work thorough its CD program which entails: • Review of current social risks by external expert. • Development of detailed and targeted, topic-specific Social Management Plans (SMP). • Edit and add on to existing policies and procedures. • Provide training to implement new and updated policies.
